root_causes.title: Unbound @dev version constraints in composer.json require section

related_findings.title: Unbound @dev version constraints in composer.json require section
related_findings.description: composer.json specifies '@dev' for 'alex-kassel/laravel-domain-core', 'alex-kassel/stable-fingerprint', and 'roach-php/laravel'. Releasing a package to Packagist with @dev root requirements breaks SemVer resolution for downstream consumers.
related_findings.recommendation: Update dependency constraints to semantic version bounds (e.g., ^2.0 for domain-core and stable-fingerprint, and ^2.0 || ^3.0 for roach-php/laravel).

root_causes.title: Missing essential release documentation and legal files (README.md, LICENSE, CHANGELOG.md)

related_findings.title: Missing essential release documentation and legal files (README.md, LICENSE, CHANGELOG.md)
related_findings.description: packages/alex-local/scraper-core does not contain a README.md explaining installation and architecture, a LICENSE file specifying open-source terms, or a CHANGELOG.md documenting version history.
related_findings.evidence: README.md, LICENSE, and CHANGELOG.md are absent from packages/alex-local/scraper-core root.
related_findings.recommendation: Compose README.md according to .agents/rules/readme.md standard with 7-badge palette, add MIT LICENSE, and create CHANGELOG.md (Keep-a-Changelog).

root_causes.title: 90 PHPStan level max typing errors across Eloquent models, DTOs, and Console commands

related_findings.title: 90 PHPStan level max typing errors across Eloquent models, DTOs, and Console commands
related_findings.description: Static analysis detected missing generic annotations on Eloquent relationships (BelongsTo, HasMany), missing generic types on ArrayAccess in RawContentItem, unsafe string casting in Console commands, and unannotated array shape casts.
related_findings.evidence: PHPStan reported 90 errors at level max (missingType.generics, missingType.iterableValue, cast.string, argument.type).
related_findings.recommendation: Add full PHPDoc generic annotations to model relationships, specify array shapes and generics for ArrayAccess, and cleanly type console command option resolution.

root_causes.title: Missing .gitattributes with export-ignore rules for release archive build

related_findings.title: Missing .gitattributes with export-ignore rules for release archive build
related_findings.description: No .gitattributes file exists in packages/alex-local/scraper-core. When building a release zip via git archive, tests, build caches, and configuration files would leak into production consumer installations.
related_findings.evidence: File .gitattributes does not exist in package root.
related_findings.recommendation: Create .gitattributes with standard eol=lf and export-ignore for tests/, phpunit.xml, .phpunit.result.cache, etc.

root_causes.title: Spiders table defines unique constraint on ['slug'] instead of composite ['domain', 'slug']
root_causes.decision_context:
Option A (Recommended): Update unique constraint in migration to ['domain', 'slug'] allowing duplicate spider slugs across independent domains sharing a single database.
Option B: Maintain unique(['slug']) enforcing globally unique spider slugs across all domains.

related_findings.title: Spiders table defines unique constraint on ['slug'] instead of composite ['domain', 'slug']
related_findings.description: In database/migrations/2026_01_01_000000_create_scraper_tables.php, the spiders table creates a unique index on ['slug']. While default domain architecture uses isolated per-domain databases, if multiple domains share a single database, two spiders with the same slug across different domains will collide.
related_findings.recommendation: Decide whether spider slugs should be unique globally or per domain (unique(['domain', 'slug'])).
related_findings.decision_context:
Option A (Recommended): Keep unique(['domain', 'slug']) to allow identical spider slugs across different business domains when sharing a database.
Option B: Keep unique(['slug']) requiring globally unique spider slugs across all domains.

root_causes.title: 22 files in package fail Pint PSR-12 / PER-CS 2.0 formatting checks

related_findings.title: 22 files in package fail Pint PSR-12 / PER-CS 2.0 formatting checks
related_findings.description: Running Pint in test mode identified 22 files with unformatted docblocks, spacing around concatenation, import ordering, and braces position.
related_findings.evidence: php vendor/bin/pint packages/alex-local/scraper-core --test exited with code 1 (22 files failed).
related_findings.recommendation: Run php vendor/bin/pint packages/alex-local/scraper-core to automatically fix styling issues across all files.

root_causes.title: ScraperCoreServiceProvider does not provide standard publishable config or migration tags

related_findings.title: ScraperCoreServiceProvider does not provide standard publishable config or migration tags
related_findings.description: ScraperCoreServiceProvider does not register publishes() tags for default package config or standalone database migrations, relying solely on domain context registration in AbstractScrapingServiceProvider.
related_findings.evidence: ScraperCoreServiceProvider::boot() only registers console commands without publishes() tags or mergeConfigFrom().
related_findings.recommendation: Provide config publication and migration publication tags in ScraperCoreServiceProvider for standalone or hybrid consumer configurations.

root_causes.title: Missing explicit index on raw_content_missing_periods.raw_content_id for high-volume analytics queries

related_findings.title: Missing explicit index on raw_content_missing_periods.raw_content_id for high-volume analytics queries
related_findings.description: Foreign keys are constrained with cascade delete, but explicit composite indexes for raw_content_missing_periods range queries (raw_content_id, missing_since_at) enhance PostgreSQL/MySQL query performance.
related_findings.evidence: Schema::create('raw_content_missing_periods', ...) defines foreignId without explicit index() on composite missing queries.
related_findings.recommendation: Add index on ['raw_content_id', 'missing_since_at'] for optimized historical queries.

related_findings.title: Missing Packagist discovery metadata in composer.json (keywords, homepage, support)
related_findings.description: composer.json is missing keywords, homepage, and support links required for high-quality open-source distribution on Packagist.
related_findings.evidence: composer.json lacks keywords, homepage, and support blocks.
related_findings.recommendation: Populate keywords, homepage, and support links in composer.json.

root_causes.title: Missing GitHub Actions CI workflow for automated matrix testing

related_findings.title: Missing GitHub Actions CI workflow for automated matrix testing
related_findings.description: packages/alex-local/scraper-core lacks a .github/workflows/tests.yml file to continuously test pull requests across PHP 8.2, 8.3, 8.4 and Laravel 11, 12, 13 on Ubuntu and Windows runners.
related_findings.evidence: Directory .github/workflows does not exist in package root.
related_findings.recommendation: Create .github/workflows/tests.yml with matrix testing strategy using composer update --prefer-dist.

root_causes.title: Internal pipeline processors in src/Processors lack @internal annotations

related_findings.title: Internal pipeline processors in src/Processors lack @internal annotations
related_findings.description: SaveRawContentProcessor and ConsoleProgressProcessor are internal engine components meant to be configured by AbstractSpider, but lack @internal class annotations.
related_findings.evidence: Class SaveRawContentProcessor and ConsoleProgressProcessor are public in PSR-4 root without docblock boundary markup.
related_findings.recommendation: Add @internal docblock annotations to internal pipeline processors.
